accepted.direction: -1 if upper.value < lower.value; 1 if upper.value > lower.value; otherwise 0
accepted.rails: if input.direction = 0, input rails; otherwise atomically apply both proposals, merging equal values at an equal target

evaluation_order: reject a request whose bytes do not decode to the declared request codec
if input.cycles = 18446744073709551615, return domain-exceeded with input state
decode lower nibble instruction & 15 and upper nibble instruction >> 4
from the immutable input snapshot compute lower then upper proposals in mathematical integers
if either proposal is outside signed-i32, return domain-exceeded with input state
derive next direction by exact comparison of upper.value and lower.value
if input.direction != 0 and targets are equal but values differ, return write-conflict with input state
otherwise return accepted with the declared next state

proposal.input_snapshot: both proposals read the unchanged input rails and direction
proposal.value: rails[target] + direction * rails[source] evaluated over mathematical integers
